Our facility once sourced advanced photonic circuitry from a nearby robotics manufacturer.  Their building suffered major damage during the portal storms, and collapsed almost entirely.  However, preliminary scouting reveals that the basement prototyping lab likely remains intact."

"Completion of this contract awards 8 HGC, the standard heightened-hazard rate.  We are also willing to provide you with a set of protective gear at a considerable discount upon acceptance of the contract.

records.catalogKey: ["","Psionics are different in several ways than the magical powers in Magiclysm.  For one, all psionics require stamina to use rather than an external resource such as mana, meaning a full-charged psion is only a short breather away.  Second, psionic powers scale with your intelligence stat and with your Nether Attunement (q.v.) as well as with the power level; this includes their maximum possible level, which is equal to your intelligence times 1.5.  Third, long-duration powers must be concentrated on to be maintained, and negative effects like being injured, being electrocuted, or inhaling toxic smoke can cause you to lose your concentration.  Lose your concentration when you're levitating or maintaining a pyrokinetic shield against fire and you're in for a world of hurt and possibly the character creation screen."]
records.singular: Psionics are different in several ways than the magical powers in Magiclysm.  For one, all psionics require stamina to use rather than an external resource such as mana, meaning a full-charged psion is only a short breather away.  Second, psionic powers scale with your intelligence stat and with your Nether Attunement (q.v.) as well as with the power level; this includes their maximum possible level, which is equal to your intelligence times 1.5.  Third, long-duration powers must be concentrated on to be maintained, and negative effects like being injured, being electrocuted, or inhaling toxic smoke can cause you to lose your concentration.  Lose your concentration when you're levitating or maintaining a pyrokinetic shield against fire and you're in for a world of hurt and possibly the character creation screen.

nearbyTranslatedTerminology.singular: Welcome to Mind Over Matter, a psychic powers mod for Cataclysm.  This mod adds psionics to the game based on classical concepts of mental powers.  Incinerate zombies as a pyrokinetic, avoid bullets by peering into the near future as a clairsentient, recharge your car as an electrokinetic, run so fast you can run on water as a biokinetic, and more.  All these powers are available to you.
nearbyTranslatedTerminology.ja: Cataclysmの超能力MOD、Mind Over Matterへようこそ。このMODは古典的な精神力の概念に基づいた超能力をゲームに追加します。パイロキネシスでゾンビを焼き尽くし、クレアセンシェンスで一瞬先の未来を予測し弾丸を避け、エレクトロキネシスで車両を充電し、バイオキネシスで水上を移動できるほど素早く走る。様々な能力を活用できるようになります。

nearbyTranslatedTerminology.singular: And to your enemies.  The player is not the only one with psionics.
nearbyTranslatedTerminology.ja: しかし、それは敵も同じです。超能力を身につけているのはプレイヤーだけではありません。

nearbyTranslatedTerminology.singular: Finally, psionics are taxing on the body and each usage of a power requires caloric expenditure.  This is treated the same as any other caloric expenditure, causing weariness when it grows large enough and eventually rendering you exhausted.  Psionics are work.
nearbyTranslatedTerminology.ja: 最後に、超能力の発動は身体に負担が掛かり、発動の度にカロリーを消費します。これは他のカロリー消費行動と同様に、使い続けると疲労し、最終的には倦怠感を引き起こします。超能力も運動のようなものと言えますね。

nearbyTranslatedTerminology.singular: Mind Over Matter: Gaining Psionic Powers
nearbyTranslatedTerminology.ja: Mind Over Matter: 超能力の習得

nearbyTranslatedTerminology.singular: There are three main ways to gain psionic powers: start the game with them, find and use a matrix crystal, or exposure yourself to the raging energies of a portal storm.
nearbyTranslatedTerminology.ja: 超能力を習得する主な方法は、超能力を身につけたキャラクターで開始する、マトリクス結晶を見つけて使う、荒れ狂うポータル嵐のエネルギーに身を晒す、この三つです。

nearbyTranslatedTerminology.singular: The first and most obvious is start the game with them.  There are professions for each psionic path, such as "Doomseer" for clairsentience or "Itzcuauhtli Corps Liaison, Yohualli Ehēcatl Division" for teleportation, and each path also has a series of three backgrounds entitled Newly-Awakened, Arising, and Ascended.  Newly-Awakened starts you with the absolute minimum possible, only a couple powers.  Arising starts you with a good amount of powers, equivalent to a mid-game character.  Ascended starts you with a very powerful suite of psionics best suited for games where monster difficulty has been significantly increased or other challenges are at play.
nearbyTranslatedTerminology.ja: 一つ目、超能力を身につけたキャラクターで開始するのが最も分かりやすい方法です。クレアセンシェンスの力をもつ「破滅の預言者」、テレポーターの「ｲﾂｸｧｳﾄﾘ軍ﾖﾜﾘ･ｴｴｶﾄﾙ隊連絡員」などの職業があり、技量に応じて生い立ちを「原石」「開花」「真髄」の中から選べます。「原石」は最低限の力しかありません。「開花」はゲーム中盤でも通用する十分な力があります。「覚醒」は大幅に強化されたモンスターが出現するような難易度が高いゲームに打ってつけの、非常に頼もしい超能力が揃った状態で開始します。

nearbyTranslatedTerminology.singular: The second is to find one of the strange colored crystals now found in the world, and the third is to stand out in a portal storm unprotected.  Using a matrix crystal works immediately and standing in a portal storm is a small chance each moment, but the effect is the same.  If you succeed, you gain a power path appropriate to the type of crystal, or randomly in the case of a portal storm.  If you fail, you suffer from negative effects related to your failure.  A failed biokinetic awakening will leave you physically weakened, for example, and a failed telekinetic awakening causes unseen forces to press down and inhibit your movement.
nearbyTranslatedTerminology.ja: 二つ目は、現在世界中で見つかっている奇妙な結晶を使う方法、三つ目は、ポータルの嵐に身を晒す方法です。様々な色のマトリクス結晶を使うとすぐに習得の成否が判定されます。発生しているポータル嵐の中心部に辿り着ける機会は稀ですが、やはりすぐに成否が決まります。成功すると結晶の色に対応する分野の超能力を習得します。ポータル嵐の場合は、習得できる超能力の分野はランダムです。失敗すると、習得しようとした超能力に関連する悪影響を受けます。例えば、バイオキネシスの習得に失敗すると肉体が衰弱し、テレキネシスの習得に失敗すると、不可視の力に圧倒されて動きが妨げられます。

records.catalogKey: ["","Unlike learning spells, psionics are not guaranteed.  Each newly-created character has only a chance to gain powers.  This chance is variable per character, set when your character is created, and can range from 50% to as little as 1%.  Furthermore, every path you learn decreases your odds to learn future paths, though it never becomes impossible.  You may take the Latent Psion trait at character creation to ensure that your first attempt to awaken psionic powers is always successful, but this does affect the diminishing returns of attempting to awaken additional paths.  You do not need to take this trait if you start the game with any type of psionic powers; starting psions are assumed to have been latent."]

nearbyTranslatedTerminology.singular: The first and most obvious is start the game with them. Newly-Awakened starts you with the absolute minimum possible, only a couple powers.  Arising starts you with a good amount of powers, equivalent to a mid-game character. records.singular: Mind Over Matter: Psychic Knacks

nearbyTranslatedTerminology.ja: Mind Over Matter: 異界同調

nearbyTranslatedTerminology.singular: Stamina and concentration are not the only limitations on your powers.  Another is Nether Attunement, though it is both a limitation and a path to power.
nearbyTranslatedTerminology.ja: 超能力を縛る制約は、スタミナと精神統一だけではありません。異界同調は制約であると同時に、更に力を高めるチャンスでもあります。

nearbyTranslatedTerminology.singular: Psionics is the psychoactive power of the Nether channeled by careful concentration.  Repeated use of psionics in a short period of time opens the connection to the Nether wider, increasing the amount of power available.  Higher levels of Nether Attunement boost all characteristics of your powers: range, damage, duration, targets affected, bonus granted or penalty caused, and so on.  At 12, the maximum degree of Nether Attunement, your powers are over five times stronger than with no Nether Attunement!
nearbyTranslatedTerminology.ja: 超能力は、細心の注意を払って異界とチャネリングすることで精神を活性化し力を発揮します。超能力を短期間に繰り返し使うことで異界との繋がりが強まり、力自体も変化します。異界同調値が上がると、各超能力の範囲、威力、効果時間、標的の範囲、付与ボーナス、ペナルティ軽減といった、様々な強化を得られます。異界同調値が最大の12に達した場合、0のときと比べて5倍以上強化されます。

nearbyTranslatedTerminology.singular: Nether Attunement has a chance to rise when using any power or when maintaining concentration on a power.  Higher-difficulty powers have a greater chance of causing Nether Attunement, and using more powers in quick succession also raises the chance.
nearbyTranslatedTerminology.ja: 異界同調値は、超能力を行使したとき、そして精神統一を続けているときに、上昇する可能性があります。難易度の高い超能力を使ったときや、超能力を連続して使っているときは、異界同調値が上昇しやすくなります。

nearbyTranslatedTerminology.ja: 冷凍冬眠装置の緩やかな処置進行の間に、サルスIVの様々な表情を眺められました。宇宙の闇を背景に赤く照らされる大理石、銀白色の鏡面、広大な氷河を切り崩すように赤道大都市圏の遺跡が散らばる終末世界。やがて、オーガストムーン宇宙港の年季の入った船体が覗き窓の大部分を遮り、船内コンピュータが下船の時間を告げました。
